decisions.statement: A specifier naming no path of its own is a package.
A package names no file to carry an extension.
A relative specifier with no extension is refused where the file it names stands.
A specifier no file of these extensions stands at is let through.
A relative specifier with any other extension is refused where that file stands.
A specifier is judged where the specifier is written.
No compiler setting decides the answer.

definition: the check refusing a relative specifier written without the extension of the file it names
